tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_quarter_ss idealized supercell (GNU real32 build, dx = 2 km, dt = 12 s, 40 layers, WSM6 only) dumped by the instrumented ctessum-claude/WRF fork (module_esm_dump with esm_dump_inner hooks inside mp_wsm6_run of the ctessum-claude/MMM-physics fork, commit 52cfbd7) and replayed through the real64 (kind_phys = real64) standalone kernels/wsm6_driver at the WRF step. The block is an in-place step, so the test is an INCREMENT test over the kernel's sub-step dtcld = 12 s (no small-dt replay; the increments are the quantities the kernel applies): the inputs are the state at the start of the block -- the kernel's input temperature t and cloud water qc (untouched before the block), den, p, the start-of-step cpm and xl, and the post-sedimentation rain, snow, graupel and cloud ice, which the kernel does not dump and are reconstructed exactly from what it does dump: qs = qs_rates - psmlt, qg = qg_rates - pgmlt - pgfrz, qr = qr_rates + psmlt + pgmlt + pgfrz, qi = qi_rates + pimlt - pihmf - pihtf, where psmlt and pgmlt are the dumped increments, pimlt = qc_rates - qc (warm layers), pihmf = qc (layers colder than -40 C), pihtf = qc - qc_rates - pihmf (other cold layers) follow from the cloud-water budget and pgfrz from the energy budget (t_rates - T_after_melting_and_cloud_freezing) cpm/(xls - xl) of the real64 replay. The expected values are the dumped psmlt/pgmlt increments, the budget-derived pimlt/pihmf/pihtf/pgfrz increments, and the state after the block (t_rates, qc/qi/qr/qs/qg_rates). Residual esm-vs-real64 mismatch: the kernel's real32 constants and literals (FORTRAN_BUGS.md N2), in particular pfrz2 = 0.6600000262 whose rounding is amplified by the 50 K supercooling cap to 1.3e-6 relative in exp(pfrz2 supcol) and hence in pihtf_rate and pgfrz_rate; and t0c = 273.1499939 K, whose 6e-6 K offset is amplified by the melting rates being proportional to T - T0 = 0.15 K in the only unlimited melting layer (1.6e-5 relative). Measured with zero tolerances: the melting increments agree to 1.6e-5 relative where unlimited (exactly where limited, since then they equal the frozen mass), pihtf to 2.7e-6 relative, pgfrz to 1e-9 absolute (1.4e-6 of column maximum), and the final temperature to 8e-7 K (the pgfrz rounding times L_f/cpm). Tolerances: melting increments Linf 1e-4 of column maximum and rel 5e-5 spot checks at the one layer (8) where the increment is unlimited (rate x dtcld is below the snow/graupel mass), which also pins psmlt_rate and pgmlt_rate = increment/dtcld there; freezing increments Linf 1e-5 of column maximum and rel 1e-5 spot checks at unlimited layers; pimlt/pihmf exact (abs 0); final state Linf 2e-6 K (rel 1e-8 spot checks) and 1e-6 of the column maximum of each species (1e-4 for snow, which inherits the melting tolerance). Regime: supercell step 250 (t = 50 min), row j = 23, column i = 25: layers 1-8 above 0 C with all snow melting out in 2-7 and the snow and graupel melting unlimited in layer 8 (T = 273.3 K); cloud ice melts in the same layers; heterogeneous freezing of cloud water in layers 12-19 (unlimited) and homogeneous freezing above layer 20 (T < -40 C); rain freezes in layers 9-15 (unlimited, up to 1.4e-4 kg/kg) and completely from layer 16 up.

input_qi.expr: qi_rates + np.where(t0c - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) < 0, qc_rates - qc, 0) - np.where(t0c - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) > 0, qc - qc_rates, 0)

input_qr.expr: qr_rates + psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw + np.where(t0c - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) > 0, (t_rates - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) - (xls - xl)/cpm*(qc - qc_rates))*cpm/(xls - xl), 0)

input_qg.expr: qg_rates - pgmlt_raw - np.where(t0c - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) > 0, (t_rates - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) - (xls - xl)/cpm*(qc - qc_rates))*cpm/(xls - xl), 0)

assertions.expr: np.where((t0c - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) > 0) & (t0c - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) <= 40), qc - qc_rates, 0)
np.where(t0c - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) > 0, (t_rates - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) - (xls - xl)/cpm*(qc - qc_rates))*cpm/(xls - xl), 0)

tests.description: Same reference chain, reconstruction and tolerance reasoning, early storm: step 200 (t = 40 min), row j = 20 (call 7980), column i = 20: little precipitation has reached the warm layers, so the snow (1.2e-10 kg/kg) and graupel (1.4e-8) melting in layer 8 are unlimited and small; freezing is weak. tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU real32 build, dt = 60 s, 59 layers, mp = 6, sfclay = 1, slab, YSU) at call 120 (step 60, 20:00 UTC), lowest 40 of the 59 layers (esm-spec 6.6 tests cannot rebind NLEV), replayed through the real64 kernels/wsm6_driver. Zero check: no rain, snow, graupel or cloud water anywhere and cloud ice only above layer 40, so every melting and freezing increment is exactly zero and the block returns its inputs unchanged (T_out = t_rates = t to the last bit).
